# Gornergrat Railway [Experience](https://www.myswitzerland.com/en-ch/experiences/ "Experience")[Zermatt](https://www.myswitzerland.com/en-ch/destinations/zermatt/ "To the overview page «Zermatt»") Media gallery ## Overview - Open Information About Map Map ### Hint Zermatt Valais [Show on map](https://www.myswitzerland.com/en-ch/map/#around:46.0236895289399,7.74788586606218;cat:e7bd1c2b-91dd-4d6a-b937-be4909cd36cc;lat:46.02369;lng:7.74789;z:15 "Auf Karte zeigen") Shoot Information About Map - Open Information About Contact Address ### Contact **Gornergrat Bahn** Bahnhof 3920 Zermatt Phone  [+41 (0)84 864 24 42](tel:+41848642442 "+41 (0)84 864 24 42") [gornergrat.ch](https://www.gornergrat.ch/ "Website") [Plan your route](https://www.google.com/maps/dir/?api=1&destination=45.98329383725286%2C7.7833225628112315 "Plan your route") Shoot Information About Contact ## Intro Surrounded by no fewer than 29 peaks above 4,000 meters, such as the majestic Matterhorn and the Dufourspitze as well as the third-longest glacier of the Alps, Gornergrat rewards visitors with unparalleled views. Gornergrat is one of the most popular destinations near Zermatt. The adventure begins with the ride on the Gornergrat Railway which offers magnificent views of the Matterhorn. The panoramic views from the top are breathtaking: mountains and glaciers as far as the eye can see. Surrounded by more than two dozen four-thousand-metre peaks – including the Matterhorn, the imposing Dufourspitze and the Dom – and several glaciers, Gornergrat rewards with an unforgettable panorama. In summer, marvel at the reflection of the Matterhorn in the surface of the Riffelsee and enjoy scenic hiking trails to the Alpine Garden or the famous Valais Blacknose Sheep. In winter, the beautiful tobogganing route from Rotenboden to Riffelberg is just one of the experiences on offer. Together with sunny ski slopes, snowshoe and hiking trails Gornergrat is sure to delight both young and old. The Gornergrat is also home to the multimedia experience “ZOOOM the Matterhorn”, the “Golden Spot” photo point, and a viewing platform, which can be visited all year round. ### Information | **Altitude:** | 3,089 m a.s.l. | | **Arrival:** | Train from [Brig](https://www.myswitzerland.com/en-ch/destinations/brig/)/ [Visp](https://www.myswitzerland.com/en-ch/destinations/visp/) to Zermatt, from [Zermatt](https://www.myswitzerland.com/en-ch/destinations/zermatt/) by cog railway to the Gornergrat | | **Timetable:** | Operates year-round, during the high season in 24-minute intervals | | **Travel duration to summit:** | 33 minutes to the top, 44 minutes back | | **Attractions:** | Gornergrat Railway ride, view over 29 peaks above 4,000 m a.s.l., the glaciers of Monte Rosa, reflection of Matterhorn in Lake Riffel (visible in calm weather) | | **Food & beverage:** | Restaurant with a view onto Monte Rosa mountain massif, self-service restaurant | | **Specials:** | - [NostalChic Class](https://www.gornergrat.ch/en/stories/nostalchic-class) – the most exclusive way to travel to the Gornergrat in a nostalgic coach. Enjoy the exclusive ambience, infos from a local guide and regional culinary delicacies
- [GoldenSpot & Viewing Platform](https://www.gornergrat.ch/en/stories/golden-spot) – a historic locomotive 3003 from the first generation of the Gornergrat Railway is displayed in gold. The ideal place for a souvenir photo with the Matterhorn in the background
- [ZOOOM the Matterhorn](https://www.gornergrat.ch/en/pages/zooom-the-matterhorn) – a multimedia experience on the Gornergrat summit
- 50% discount with Swiss Travel Pass, Swiss Travel Pass Flex and Swiss Half Fare Card
[Purchase your ticket online](https://www.gornergrat.ch/en/pages/ticket?utm_source=STS&utm_medium=verweis&utm_campaign=STSpartnerlink) | ### Mountain day trips Buy your mountain rail ascent return tickets now [Timetable and tickets](https://www.sbb.ch/en/buying/pages/fahrplan/fahrplan.xhtml?&nach=Gornergrat) [![](https://media.myswitzerland.com/image/fetch/c_fit,w_200,h_200/f_auto,q_auto/https://www.myswitzerland.com/-/media/st/images/logos/gornergratbahn-ggb-logo-2023.jpg)\\ \\ Gornergrat Bahn](https://www.gornergrat.ch/) [![](https://media.myswitzerland.com/image/fetch/c_fit,w_200,h_200/f_auto,q_auto/https://www.myswitzerland.com/-/media/st/images/swisstainable%20logos/swisstainable-commited-st0072834.png)\\ \\* Committed](http://www.swisstainable.ch/) [![](https://media.myswitzerland.com/image/fetch/c_fit,w_200,h_200/f_auto,q_auto/https://www.myswitzerland.com/-/media/st/images/swisstainable%20logos/swisstainable-engaged-st0072835.png)\\ \\*\\* Engaged](http://www.swisstainable.ch/) ### SBB RailAway leisure offer With SBB RailAway leisure offers, you receive attractive discounts on leisure attractions and travel on public transport.
